---
title: "Explore the saved results"
---

These views use saved aggregate results from `Jobs_2026_US`. Hover for values,
drag to zoom, and use the chart toolbar to reset or download a PNG. The analysis
code is displayed on the [code page](analysis_code.qmd); Python and Spark do not
run during publication or when you browse. JavaScript provides the interactions.
